name: 程序设计基础
description: Programming in Python and C++. Variables, control flow, functions, recursion, object-oriented programming, debugging and unit testing. Students implement and test small software programs.

name: 数据结构与算法
description: Data structures and algorithms: arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs and hash tables. Sorting, searching, graph traversal, dynamic programming and asymptotic time and space complexity.

name: 高等数学
description: Single and multivariable calculus. Limits, continuity, differentiation, partial derivatives, integration, infinite series and ordinary differential equations. Mathematical analysis and proof exercises.

name: 线性代数
description: Linear algebra: vector spaces, matrices, systems of linear equations, determinants, eigenvalues, eigenvectors, orthogonality and matrix decomposition. Applications of linear transformations.

name: 概率论与数理统计
description: Probability theory and mathematical statistics. Random variables, probability distributions, conditional probability, expectation, variance, sampling, parameter estimation, hypothesis testing and linear regression.

name: 机器学习
description: Machine learning and statistical learning: supervised classification and regression, model selection and cross-validation. Statistical estimation, probability distributions, optimization and gradient descent. Practical implementation of learning algorithms in Python.

name: 数据库系统
description: Relational databases and data management. Entity relationship modeling, relational algebra, SQL queries, normalization, transactions, indexing and database design. Implementation of a small database application.

name: 软件工程
description: Software engineering: requirements analysis, object-oriented software design, architecture, version control, unit and integration testing, agile development and collaborative software project implementation.
